description_en: Modifies the configurations of a UDP listener
kebab_example: aliyun slb set-load-balancer-udp-listener-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1rtfnodmywb43ecu4sf-c0000 --listener-port 80 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetLoadBalancerUDPListenerAttribute

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the classic Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to obtain region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the classic Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance
parameters.help_zh: 传统型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The frontend port used by the classic Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例前端使用的端口。

取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: listener_port

parameters.help_en:
The peak bandwidth of the listener. Unit: Mbit/s. Valid values:

-1: For an Internet-facing Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance that uses pay-by-traffic billing, you can change the peak bandwidth Settings to -1, which indicates that the peak bandwidth is not limited.
  
1 to 5120: For an Internet-facing Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance that uses pay-by-bandwidth billing, you can set the peak bandwidth for each listener. However, the sum of the peak bandwidth values of all listeners cannot exceed the peak bandwidth of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
监听的带宽峰值，单位：Mbps。取值：

-1：对于按流量计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以将带宽峰值设置为-1，即不限制带宽峰值。
  
1~5120： 对于按带宽计费的公网负载均衡实例，可以设置每个监听的带宽峰值，但所有监听的带宽峰值之和不能超过实例的带宽峰值
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en:
The scheduling algorithm. Valid values:

wrr: Backend servers with higher weights have a higher polling frequency (probability). If backend servers have the same weight, the backend server with fewer current connections has a higher polling frequency (probability).

rr: Requests are distributed to backend servers in the order of access.

sch: Consistent hash algorithm based on source IP addresses. Requests from the same source IP address are scheduled to the same backend server.

tch: Consistent hash algorithm based on 4-tuples (source IP address, destination IP address, source port, and destination port). Requests from the same flow are scheduled to the same backend server.

qch: Consistent hash algorithm based on QUIC connection IDs. Requests with the same QUIC connection ID are scheduled to the same backend server.

Only high-performance instances support the sch, tch, and qch scheduling algorithms.
CLB does not support changing the wrr or rr algorithm to a consistent hash algorithm, nor does it support switching between consistent hash algorithms
parameters.help_zh:
调度算法。取值：

wrr：权重值越高的后端服务器，被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。当权重值相同时，当前连接数越小的后端服务器被轮询到的次数（概率）也越高。

rr：按照访问顺序依次将外部请求依序分发到后端服务器。

sch：基于源IP地址的一致性哈希算法，相同的源地址会调度到相同的后端服务器。

tch：基于四元组的一致性哈希算法（源IP、目的IP、源端口和目的端口），相同的流会调度到相同的后端服务器。

qch：基于QUIC Connection ID一致性哈希算法，相同的QUIC Connection ID会调度到相同的后端服务器。

仅有性能保障型实例支持sch、tch和qch的调度算法。
CLB不支持wrr和rr算法变更为一致性哈希算法，也不支持一致性哈希算法互转
parameters.name: scheduler

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive successful health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared healthy (from fail to success).

Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续成功多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由fail判定为success。

取值范围：1~10
parameters.name: healthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The number of consecutive failed health checks that must occur before a backend server is declared unhealthy (from success to fail).

Valid values: 1 to 10
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查连续失败多少次后，将后端服务器的健康检查状态由success判定为fail。

取值范围：1~10
parameters.name: unhealthy_threshold

parameters.help_en:
The timeout period for a health check response. If a backend Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance does not send a correct response within the specified timeout period, the health check fails. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 300.

If the value of HealthCheckConnectTimeout is less than the value of HealthCheckInterval, HealthCheckConnectTimeout is ignored and the timeout period is the value of HealthCheckInterval
parameters.help_zh:
接收来自运行状况检查的响应需要等待的时间。如果后端ECS在指定的时间内没有正确响应，则判定为健康检查失败。单位：秒。

取值范围：1~300。

如果HealthCheckConnectTimeout的值小于HealthCheckInterval的值，则HealthCheckConnectTimeout无效，超时时间为HealthCheckInterval的值
parameters.name: health_check_connect_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The port used for health checks.

Valid values: 1 to 65535
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查使用的端口。

取值范围：1~65535
parameters.name: health_check_connect_port

parameters.help_en:
The interval between two consecutive health checks. Unit: seconds.

Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh:
健康检查的时间间隔，单位：秒。

取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: health_check_interval

parameters.help_en: The request string for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: UDP监听健康检查的请求串，只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为64个字符
parameters.name: health_check_req

parameters.help_en: The response string for UDP listener health checks. The string can contain only letters and digits, and can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: UDP监听健康检查的响应串，只允许包含字母、数字，最大长度限制为64个字符
parameters.name: health_check_exp

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a vServer group (virtual service group). Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no.

Only one of VServerGroup and MasterSlaveServerGroup can be set to on
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用虚拟服务器组。取值：
on：是。
off：否。

VserverGroup和MasterSlaveServerGroup只允许一个值为on
parameters.name: vserver_group

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vServer group (virtual service group)
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟服务器组ID
parameters.name: vserver_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary/secondary server group.

You can specify only one of the vServer group (virtual service group) ID and the primary/secondary server group ID
parameters.help_zh:
主备服务器组ID。

虚拟服务器组ID和主备服务器组ID只能选择一个
parameters.name: master_slave_server_group_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a primary/secondary server group. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no.

Only one of VServerGroup and MasterSlaveServerGroup can be set to on
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用主备服务器组。取值：
on：是。
off：否。

VserverGroup和MasterSlaveServerGroup只允许取值为on
parameters.name: master_slave_server_group

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the access control list (ACL) to which the listener is bound.

This parameter is required when AclStatus is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
监听绑定的访问策略组ID。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数必选
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en:
The access control type. Valid values:

white: Only requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks configured in the Settings of the selected access control policy group are forwarded. Whitelists apply to scenarios in which only specific IP addresses are allowed to access the application. Using a whitelist poses business risks. After a whitelist is configured, only IP addresses in the whitelist can access the Server Load Balancer (SLB) listener. 

    If a whitelist is enabled but no IP addresses are added to the policy group, the Server Load Balancer (SLB) listener forwards all requests.

black: Requests from the IP addresses or CIDR blocks configured in the Settings of the selected access control policy group are not forwarded. Blacklists apply to scenarios in which specific IP addresses are blocked from accessing the application. 
  
    If a blacklist is enabled but no IP addresses are added to the policy group, the Server Load Balancer (SLB) listener forwards all requests.

This parameter takes effect only when AclStatus is set to on
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制类型。取值：

white： 仅转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段的请求，白名单适用于只允许特定IP访问的场景。设置白名单存在一定业务风险。一旦设置白名单，就只有白名单中的IP可以访问负载均衡监听。 

    如果开启了白名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

black： 不会转发来自所选访问控制策略组中设置的IP地址或地址段，黑名单适用于只限制某些特定IP访问的场景。 
  
    如果开启了黑名单访问，但访问策略组中没有添加任何IP，则负载均衡监听会转发全部请求。

当AclStatus参数的值为on时，该参数有效
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
on: yes.
off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制功能。取值：
on：是。
off：否
parameters.name: acl_status

parameters.help_en:
The custom name of the listener.

The name must be 1 to 256 characters in length, and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), forward slashes (/), periods (.), and underscores (_)
parameters.help_zh:
自定义监听名称。

长度限制为1~256个字符，支持中文、字母、数字、短划线（-）、正斜线（/）、半角句号（.）和下划线（_）
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the Proxy Protocol to pass the client source IP address to backend servers. Valid values:

true: yes.
false (default): no
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持通过Proxy Protocol协议携带客户端源地址到后端服务器。取值：

true：是。
false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: proxy_protocol_v2_enabled

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable health checks. Valid values:

on (default): yes.

off: no
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启健康检查。取值：

on（默认值）：开启。

off：不开启
parameters.name: health_check_switch

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform only a dry run on the request. Valid values:

true: performs a dry run and does not perform the actual operation. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual operation if the request passes the dry run
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会执行操作。如果检查通过，则返回错误码 `DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后执行操作
parameters.name: dry_run
